fragment: This 3D-printed strip holder successfully overcomes the physical bottleneck of hypoxia caused by full submersion of test strips, converting our yeast biosensor into a deployable physical product. By precisely tuning liquid layer thickness and the chamber microenvironment, the hardware enables rapid and reproducible colorimetric signal output, laying a solid foundation for our final portable, intuitive, field-ready yeast test-strip detection device.
decision: Restore the author original and preserve differences between submitted documents; user decision 2026-10-18
